recognize_zh: 整片密集排列的中小型淋巴細胞呈強烈、完整的細胞膜型（membranous）免疫染色；此為表面標記染色，本身無法單獨確立被套細胞淋巴瘤，需搭配 cyclin D1／SOX11。
features: Diffuse sheet of densely packed, medium-sized lymphoid cells
Strong, crisp circumferential membranous brown staining in nearly all tumor cells
Unstained pale nuclei that appear round to slightly irregular; nuclear detail limited by the chromogen
No residual negative background population evident in this field
Antigen not specified in the image; pattern fits a surface marker (e.g., CD20 or CD5)
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain shows a diffuse, monotonous population of medium-sized lymphoid cells with strong, uniform membranous staining. Nuclear features are partially obscured, and the specific antigen is not identified in the image. A diffuse membranous-positive neoplastic infiltrate of this type supports a mature lymphoid neoplasm, and in combination with cyclin D1 or SOX11 nuclear positivity, CD5 co-expression, and t(11;14), it is consistent with mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Also CD5+/CD20+ but shows proliferation centers, dim surface markers, LEF1/CD23 positivity and lacks cyclin D1/SOX11.
Cells are larger with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, and cyclin D1 is typically negative.
CD10/BCL6 positive and CD5/cyclin D1 negative, usually with a follicular dendritic meshwork.
CD5-negative and cyclin D1-negative, often with monocytoid cells and plasmacytic differentiation.
